IndependentPolarStudentMath.IndependentPolarQuestion: Compare rectangular and polar representation of a point.
IndependentPolarStudentMath.TeacherMathematicalAnswer: Cartesian uses signed(x,y); polar uses signed radius and directed angle(r,θ).

IndependentPolarStudentMath.IndependentPolarQuestion: Explain polar axis and pole.
IndependentPolarStudentMath.TeacherMathematicalAnswer: Pole is origin, polar axis is reference ray θ=0 along positive x-axis.

IndependentPolarStudentMath.IndependentPolarQuestion: Describe how to plot (r,θ).
IndependentPolarStudentMath.TeacherMathematicalAnswer: Rotate θ from polar axis, move radius |r| along ray if r≥0 or opposite ray if r<0.
